title: Sony WH-CH720N — halol hisob: arzimaydi
caption: 🤔 Chegirma katta, foyda kichik: Sony WH-CH720N Shovqin bostirishli quloqchin Amazon'da: $179.99 → $98 (−46%). 💰 Chetdan olib kelish • Tovar — $98 • AQShdan yetkazish — ~$10 • Bojxona — 0 so'm (200 $ normadan past) • Jami ≈ 1 266 000 so'm 🇺🇿 Toshkentda: Asaxiy — 1 309 000 so'm (oq rang) ➖ Farq atigi ≈ 43 000 so'm (3%) ❌ Xulosa: chetdan olish arzimaydi. Bir necha hafta kutasiz, rasmiy kafolat bo'lmaydi, oylik normaning yarmini band qilasiz — shu farq uchun. Toshkentdan oling. 💡 Katta foiz hali katta tejash degani emas. Doim yakuniy narxni solishtiring. 📲 Bojni ilovada hisoblang Kurs: 1 $ = 11 772,95 so'm (03.10.2026). Narxlar o'zgarishi mumkin. ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #narx
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 e-commerce discount card for a Telegram channel. Flat, modern, premium. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape covering the top ~20% of the frame.

Use the attached product photo as the hero image. Keep the product exactly as it is — do not redraw, restyle or alter it; only cut it out cleanly from its background.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1) Top row of pills: left — a solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "AMAZON" (plain text, no logo); next to it — a white pill with a thin light-grey border and grey text "AQSh"; right edge — a solid crimson (#E11D48) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "SOLISHTIRUV".
2) A large white rounded rectangle (24px radius) with a soft realistic drop shadow, about 40% of the frame height. The product photo centered inside it, with a soft studio shadow beneath.
3) Overlapping the top-right corner of that rectangle: a solid crimson (#E11D48) circle with a thin white outer ring. Inside, in white: large bold "-46%" and beneath it small uppercase "CHEGIRMA".
4) Headline in bold near-black (#11111B), large: "Sony WH-CH720N"
5) Price row: very large bold indigo (#4F46E5) "$98" and immediately to its right, smaller grey "$179.99" with a horizontal strikethrough line.
6) A light grey (#F6F6FB) rounded panel with a thin border containing:
   - small bold indigo uppercase label: "NARX SOLISHTIRUVI"
   - row: left grey text "O'zbekistonda (Asaxiy)", right bold near-black "1 309 000 so'm"
   - row: left grey text "Chetdan (tovar+yetkazish+boj)", right bold indigo "1 266 000 so'm"
   - a thin divider line
   - row: left bold amber (#D97706) uppercase "FARQ", right large bold amber (#D97706) "43 000 so'm"
7) Bottom, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right smaller grey "Chegirmalar - Kuryerlik - Bojxona"

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes:
Eski narx $179.99 — maqoladagi raqam, Amazon'da tekshirib oling. Post ataylab «arzimaydi» xulosasi bilan — kanalga ishonch beradi.
Hisob: tovar $98 + yetkazish ~$9.50 + boj $0 = $107.50 × 11772.95 = 1 266 000 so'm. Tejash: 1 309 000 − 1 266 000 = 43 000 so'm (3%).
